_about: First-load gzip budget per page in bytes: the HTML plus the CSS and JS it loads (images not counted), gzip level 9, measured by scripts/checks/dist-lib.mjs firstLoadSize(). npm run check fails if a page goes over. Set in the Nov 2026 SEO pass to the smaller of the size on main before that pass (33e0dae) and the trimmed size after it plus about 200 bytes of headroom. A new tool page uses newTool and a new non-tool page uses newPage (the largest pre-pass sizes). Adding a calculator adds a card to the homepage, so that PR may need to raise "/" by a few hundred bytes; raise any number only in a PR that says why.
